doc.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Three records with John McNeil and meeting Billy Hart
summary: They go through three Steeplechase dates with John McNeil, through which Liebman met drummer Billy Hart.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Yeah. That’s what it looks like. Next is the first of three record you did with our friend John McNeil.
Yeah. I’ll come up with the other ones later. The first is Faun, with Beirach, Buster Williams, and either Billy Hart or Mike Hymen.
Is that live from the Montmartre?
No. There’s a couple that came up later.
Yeah. That’s for Steeplechase, though they’re all for Steeplechase.
I think there’s a live one from the Montmartre.
Yes, there is. I’ll find that.
John comes out of Aebersold, meeting him at the clinics.
The second one with McNeil is from ’81 and called Clean Sweep with JoAnne Brackeen, Rufus Reid, and Billy Hart.

It’s beginning my relationship with Billy, playing record dates with him. That’s how I met Billy, through those dates and Japanese guys. That’s how I brought Billy to Quest. Richie didn’t really know Billy.
Then the third McNeil date is ’83. That’s at the Montmartre. That’s you two, and then McNeely, McClure, and Soph.
Yeah. That’s an Aebersold clinic. We’re there, and we recorded on the side.
